costs.overlap_semantics: Never add worker/owner/search components to inclusive phase totals; feature time is inside proposal time, proposal and initialization inside search time. Partial sums are explicit lower bounds.
costs.exclusions: Source-authoring time, earlier fixtures/preparation/audits and historical studies are not reconstructed here; final receipt writes excluded by original clocks. No overall speedup claim.

interpretation: Same-instance stochastic adaptation and fresh-seed evaluation only. Complete producer observations may be search unknowns. This collector cannot confer graph/policy/proof validity or held-out theorem generalization; no native proof query/acceptance.
process_status_scope: File snapshot only; no PID polling or authoritative running/terminal inference for absent receipts.
